# smart-mailto — Full Machine-Readable Documentation

## 1. Quickstart

### React Hook: `useSmartMailto`
```tsx
import { useSmartMailto } from "smart-mailto/react";

export function ContactSection() {
  const { send, isCopied, copyAddress } = useSmartMailto({
    recipient: "founders@acme.com",
    subject: "Product Inquiry",
    body: "Hi! I would like to learn more about your platform.",
    telemetry: true, // Attaches URL, timestamp, and device environment to body
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      {/* Opens Gmail / Outlook on desktop, or native mail app on mobile */}
      <button onClick={() => send()}>Email Founders</button>
      
      {/* 1-click clipboard copy fallback */}
      <button onClick={copyAddress}>{isCopied ? "Copied!" : "Copy Email"}</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Drop-in Components
```tsx
import { SmartMailtoButton, SmartMailtoMenu, SmartMailtoModal } from "smart-mailto/react";

// 1. Drop-in Semantic Button
<SmartMailtoButton recipient="team@acme.com" subject="General Inquiry">
  Contact Team
</SmartMailtoButton>

// 2. Multi-Provider Menu
<SmartMailtoMenu
  recipient="support@acme.com"
  subject="Help Request"
  triggerLabel="Get Support"
/>

// 3. Zero-Backend Contact Modal
<SmartMailtoModal
  isOpen={isOpen}
  onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
  recipient="sales@acme.com"
  title="Schedule Enterprise Demo"
  subtitle="Opens directly in your email client ready to send."
  theme="dark"
/>
```

### Vanilla TypeScript / JavaScript
```ts
import { dispatchSmartEmail } from "smart-mailto";

const button = document.getElementById("contact-button");

button?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const result = await dispatchSmartEmail({
    recipient: "founders@acme.com",
    subject: "Partnership Opportunity",
    body: "Hello! We would love to collaborate.",
  });

  console.log("Dispatched via:", result.provider);
  console.log("Popup blocked:", result.popupBlocked);
});
```

---

## 2. API Reference

### `useSmartMailto(options: SmartMailtoOptions)`
Primary React hook managing dispatch state, clipboard sync, and device detection.

#### Options:
- `recipient` (`string`, required): Destination email address.
- `subject` (`string`, optional): Prefilled subject line.
- `body` (`string`, optional): Prefilled email body text.
- `cc` (`string | string[]`, optional): Carbon copy addresses.
- `bcc` (`string | string[]`, optional): Blind carbon copy addresses.
- `preferredProvider` (`"gmail" | "outlook" | "proton" | "yahoo" | "mailto"`, optional): Force a specific provider override.
- `telemetry` (`boolean | TelemetryOptions`, optional): Whether to append page URL and timestamp metadata to the body.
- `fallbackTimeoutMs` (`number`, optional): Detection window for popup blocker detection (default: 350ms).

#### Returns:
- `send(providerOverride?)`: Function returning `Promise<DispatchResult>`.
- `copyAddress()`: Copies the recipient address to clipboard.
- `copyDraft()`: Copies recipient, subject, and body to clipboard.
- `isCopied`: Boolean indicating if copy feedback is active.
- `isDispatching`: Boolean indicating dispatch in progress.
- `isMobile`: Boolean indicating if current device was classified as mobile.

---

## 3. Core Framework-Agnostic Functions (`smart-mailto`)

- `dispatchSmartEmail(options: SmartMailtoOptions): Promise<DispatchResult>`: Core dispatcher.
- `detectClientDevice(): DeviceEnvironment`: Detects `isMobile`, `hasTouch`, `isCoarsePointer`, `screenWidth`.
- `buildProviderUrl(provider: EmailProvider, options: SmartMailtoOptions): string`: Generates clean compose URLs.
- `copyDraftToClipboard(options: SmartMailtoOptions): Promise<boolean>`: Formats and copies draft to clipboard.
- `isUrlLengthSafe(url: string, maxLength?: number): boolean`: Validates if URI is under 2,000 chars.
